title: The Frostlands
description: This mod adds a new dimension that expands on frozen biomes.
body:
![The logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39b8261b6012a452270f5e065f58d2dcd5539512.png)
Official Website Now In Beta:

Click this link to visit the site: https://emrysjedrzejczyk.wixsite.com/namelessmods

This mod adds a lot of "cool" stuff to the base game. It adds:

Explore a dangerous new dimension of ice.
Creep through structures as you find unique items and tools.
Be careful as you walk - you might sink into a powdery snow drift!
Mine new ores that could be better than netherite -- but, watch out, the land isn't safe. New enemies roam the frozen wasteland.

Current Version:

The Structures and Splahes Update

Other Features:

New Weapons
New Ores
New Plant Life
New Armor
New Items
New Biomes
Teleporters
New painting
New potions
New Structures
Custom Splash Texts
New food
New Music Discs

Bug Tracker:

If you find a bug, please tell me about it through the comments.

Video:

Click the link below to watch an explanation of what my mod adds.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EulL48_pi3eifKArTlgLhFmbDb8eDu_c/view?usp=sharing

Snapshots:

Click the link below to head to the mcreator site, where you can now download snapshots. There are also 2 forum topics where you can contact me more easily.

https://mcreator.net/modification/123005/frostlands
Snapshot 19w1a is now available on the mcreator site. To install, download it, open your CurseForge folder, click the mod folder, and move the download there. Then you can run the game. (Note: Make sure you don't have my mod from here installed, or there will be a mod conflict.)
